description: Enable Email to Postcard intake after the human requests it, with confirmed:true. Requires a production workspace key and OAuth mcp:read/mcp:write permissions. Creates a dedicated postcard- inbox while preserving the separate letter address. Returns postcardAddressState; inbox is empty until the dedicated mailbox is ready. Retry this tool to check pending setup; never invent an address or send to a pending postcardAddress. Never returns mailbox credentials. Every email delivered to the postcard address enters its separate queue, including BCC delivery; no subject prefix is required. Does not change letter rules, enable postcard autosend, check mail, buy postage or send email.
name: enable_email_to_postcard
title: Enable Email To Postcard
